policy: Actual painter against fixed independent scan poses. Two-polarity grayscale edges and Census reduce color/contrast sensitivity. metric: Symmetric one-pixel edge F1 and Census similarity: higher is better. Mean edge distance: lower is better. Component similarity, not whole-card correctness.
limitations: Mass of Ghouls remains excluded from quantitative symbol validation because its independent frame alignment failed.
MSE regular material has three calibration and five validation printings; full-art has two and two. Do not extrapolate to unrelated templates or custom symbols.
